entities.summary: Bernard Georges-Marie Gavoty, also known by the pen name Clarendon, was a French organist, musicologist, writer, talk show host and winegrower. He was known popularly for being a pundit on classical music and the pipe organ, subjects he would prolifically discuss and write various books and essays about in a manner accessible to both cognoscenti and dilettanti.
